scope: Five packed consumers and two native comparison trees; no SDK dependency or override changes.
raw_policy: raw_files, raw_archive, fix_round and fix_round2 describe unavailable historical inputs. The current catalog uses the separately retained replacement collection indexed by recollection-2026-10-16.json; every replacement file and its archive are hash-checked with --recollection. Original historical raw files were never substituted.

raw_archive.location: Workspace collection, outside the repository; no longer available (owner decision, 2026-10-16).

path_policy: Authored tarball paths use <collection>/tarballs; supplementary SBOM file references use collection-relative file:tarballs URLs. These derived path substitutions do not alter original raw bytes. Supplementary SBOM licenses move a user-defined LicenseRef- or DocumentRef- identifier from license.id to license.name, as the CycloneDX 1.5 schema requires; tools/validate.py applies the same rule to the original raw exports.
receipt_gaps: The original buyer static-import trace has no command receipt; its output is retained. A fresh trace and receipt are recorded separately for this fix round.
